turns.content: I was made redundant three months ago. I've applied to over 60 jobs and had two interviews. It's demoralising.
Job searching after redundancy is genuinely gruelling, especially with so little response. How are you managing financially?
Savings are running low. I've had to ask my parents for help which feels humiliating at my age. I'm 38.
Needing support when you're used to being independent is hard to accept. How are you spending your time while you search?
Mostly alone at home. I've stopped going to the gym. I don't see the point. I spend most days in bed honestly.
Withdrawing and losing motivation are signs that this is taking a toll beyond just the practical side. Are you eating and sleeping okay?
Not really. I feel completely worthless. Like I'm fundamentally unemployable and nothing will ever change. I've started thinking I should just disappear.
When you say disappear — can you tell me what you mean by that?
I mean like stop existing. I don't want to go into detail but it's not just a passing thought anymore. It lingers.
